caption: The drawing depicts a piece of folded woven fabric with a broad horizontal brown band running through its center. Within this brown band are repeating zigzag geometric patterns in three different color combinations: turquoise and orange, blue and off-white, and red and off-white. The rest of the fabric outside the brown band is a natural light beige color. The fabric is illustrated against a plain, similarly beige background, and the folds cast subtle shadows, giving the drawing a sense of depth. The artist's signature, "Ethel Duncan," appears beneath the fabric, slightly to the right.
title: Blanket
